status.title: Status
status.noProblems: No warnings or errors since startup.

backup.title: MyHomeLab backup
backup.description: A copy of everything in a password-protected .zip: it opens as a folder with one subfolder per area — agents, documents (also as Markdown), projects, tasks, connected apps with their logins, AI, servers, services, email, health, … — plus the keys that read the logins. Open it with 7-Zip, WinRAR or a Mac, using the backup password.
backup.downloaded: Backup downloaded. Keep it off this server.

password.title: Backup password
password.hint: Encrypts the MyHomeLab backups. Without it no backup can be restored — keep it in a password manager.
password.changeHint: Backups made before still open with the old password.
password.label: Password
password.missing: Set the backup password to be able to create backups.

jobs.description: Automatic MyHomeLab backups to a destination (Nextcloud or this server), with a frequency and how many to keep.
jobs.included: Everything goes: each database table as a .jsonl in its area folder (agentes/, documentos/, projetos/, tarefas/, apps-ligadas/, ia/, servidores/, servicos/, email/, saude/, …), documents and agent prompts also as Markdown, and in _restauro/ the TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY, JWT_SECRET and Google keys.
jobs.notIncluded: Not included: the Claude Code session stored on the server (sign in again in Settings → AI), and the address, port and database password (they belong to the install).
jobs.restore: To restore: Admin → Backup → Restore a backup, or myhomelab-restore <file> in the CT.

restore.title: Restore a backup
restore.warning: This deletes all current MyHomeLab data and puts the backup in its place, keys included. It cannot be undone from the app.
restore.safety: Before restoring, the server saves a dump of the current database in /var/backups/myhomelab; if anything fails, it goes back to it on its own.
restore.disabled: Restoring from the app only works on the server install; here, use myhomelab-restore.

steps.rollback: Going back to the previous data
